description:
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
